“I Am Chameleon VR” is a great game because it combines the excitement of hide-and-seek with virtual reality. It is similar to the PC game Meccha Chameleon, but playing in VR makes it even more immersive, as players feel like they are truly inside the game world. Hiding, searching, and exploring the environment are all very fun and engaging. For these reasons, I believe “I Am Chameleon VR” is an excellent choice for anyone who enjoys hide-and-seek and VR games.

1. There are a bunch of cheaters who just stick their dummy out the wall and cant shoot them.
